rationale: Retain the proposed write expectation, conditionally: in a writable jj workspace whose working-copy tree differs from the recorded working-copy commit, `jj log` follows the default snapshot path and writes the changed tree as a rewritten/new commit plus a repository transaction and workspace state. A clean working copy can make this path a no-op; the semantic class is write because the command can perform repository/workspace writes, not merely alter refs. This is grounded in tagged source; no VCS command or runtime measurement was executed.
